title: Shanti Inorganics IPO Details
intro:
Shanti Inorganics IPO is a book build issue of ₹41.50 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 0.50 crore shares of ₹41.50 crore.

Shanti Inorganics IPO opens for subscription on Aug 31, 2026 and closes on Sep 2, 2026. The allotment for the Shanti Inorganics IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 3, 2026. Shanti Inorganics IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 7, 2026.

Shanti Inorganics IPO is set issue price band at ₹79 to ₹83 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,65,600 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,98,400.

Vivro Financial Services Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Shanti Inorganics IPO DRHP for detailed Information.

faqs.question: How to apply in Shanti Inorganics IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Shanti Inorganics IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Shanti Inorganics IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Shanti Inorganics IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Shanti Inorganics IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Shanti Inorganics IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Shanti Inorganics IPO opens on Mon, Aug 31, 2026 and closes on Wed, Sep 2, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Shanti Inorganics IPO?
faqs.answer: Shanti Inorganics IPO lot size is 1600 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,65,600 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Shanti Inorganics IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Shanti Inorganics IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Shanti Inorganics IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Shanti Inorganics IPO will be done on Thursday, September 3, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Fri, Sep 4, 2026 . Check the Shanti Inorganics IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Shanti Inorganics IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Shanti Inorganics IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Mon, Sep 7, 2026 .
